base_field_dictionary.Br_K_zero: Br(Qbar(t))=0 by Tsen/C1; constant-Brauer ambiguity vanishes in this geometric scope
base_field_dictionary.C: the Kc generic genus-one fiber in the CV presentation
base_field_dictionary.rational_origin_consequence: degree splits Pic(Cbar)=Pic^0(Cbar) plus Z, so the H^1(K,Pic C) class of h0 is the corresponding Weil-Chatelet H^1(K,E_Kc) class

cv_brauer_to_wc_chain.gamma_nonzero_reason: R1 proves abstract J2 is outside im(x-alpha), R2 identifies corrected (f2,1) with that J2, and CV Proposition 5.1 gives the exact quotient whose kernel is im(x-alpha).
cv_brauer_to_wc_chain.gamma_of_corrected_pair: gamma(f2,1), the CV Brauer/corestriction class representing geometric J2
cv_brauer_to_wc_chain.generic_weil_chatelet_nonzero_reason: gamma(f2,1) is nonzero in Br(C)/Br0(C) and h0 is injective, hence d(f2,1)=h0(gamma(f2,1))=[xi] is nonzero in H^1(K,Pic C), equivalently in H^1(K,E_Kc) in this elliptic-with-origin setup.
cv_brauer_to_wc_chain.surface_leray_sha_interpretation: CV surfaces identifies Br X inside Br C on the generic fiber and uses the same gamma presentation; Ogg-Shafarevich identifies Br(Kc_bar) with the Tate-Shafarevich group of the elliptic K3 with section. Therefore this nonzero [xi] is the named J2 surface torsor class.

creutz_viray_curve.lemma_4_6_location: published/arXiv PDF p.15: explicit 1-cocycle representing d(ell)
creutz_viray_curve.paper: Brendan Creutz and Bianca Viray, Two torsion in the Brauer group of a hyperelliptic curve
creutz_viray_curve.proposition_5_1_location: published/arXiv PDF p.16: exact sequence; h0 is the injective Hochschild-Serre edge on Br(C)/Br0(C), and the proof identifies h0 o gamma with d

creutz_viray_surface.generic_gamma_location: published PDF section 2.3, Theorem 2.5: the generic-fiber gamma construction into Br C
creutz_viray_surface.named_class_transfer_statement: the surface class represented by ell restricts to the generic-fiber class produced by the same gamma/corestriction construction
creutz_viray_surface.paper: Brendan Creutz and Bianca Viray, On Brauer groups of double covers of ruled surfaces
creutz_viray_surface.surface_gamma_presentation_location: published PDF Corollary 5.4: Pic C/2Pic C -> Lc,E ->gamma Br X[2] -> 0
creutz_viray_surface.surface_to_generic_location: published PDF section 1.2: purity filtration Br X subset Br C subset Br k(C)=Br k(X), with Br X the vertically unramified subgroup

ogg_shafarevich.location: IMRN 2024 section 4.1, equation (4.1), immediately after Definition 4.2 / Example 4.3
ogg_shafarevich.paper: Derived Equivalence for Elliptic K3 Surfaces and Jacobians
ogg_shafarevich.statement: for an elliptic K3 surface S -> P1 with a section, Br(S) is isomorphic to the Tate-Shafarevich group Sha(S), whose elements are S-torsors

standard_phi_descent.cohomology_meaning: the squareclass d gives the E[phi]=<Tr> cocycle sigma -> Tr exactly when sigma flips sqrt(d); this homogeneous space represents its image in H^1(K,E)
standard_phi_descent.reference: Math 788 elliptic-curves Week 13 notes, section 37.8 (2-isogeny descent homogeneous spaces), formula displayed for C_d
